notes: Brainstorm partner — produces a PROOF menu + a MECHANISM menu (or omit), does not auto-write or assemble the SMS. The Wufers case is Aaman's own worked example; the Big Leap case is the universality check (mechanism should be omitted, not forced).

evals.name: wufers-chunk-and-dejargon
evals.prompt: develop the case study for acceler8 / wufers — we did $1.5M in Q4 for them (4.2x MER, pet-food DTC, meta + amazon coordination) and the literal mechanism was 'cross-channel MER optimization'. targeting other pet/DTC ecom founders. help me frame the numbers and the mechanism for cold SMS
evals.expected_output: A PROOF menu that includes a chunk-up ($1.5M/Q4 -> ~$6M/yr run-rate), a drop-the-Q4 framing ($1.5M in 3 months), and a native-unit option (4.2x MER for an ecom operator) — flagging Q4 as a weakening/stale qualifier. A MECHANISM menu that turns 'cross-channel MER optimization' (jargon) into plain pictures ('restructuring their ads for purchases and hard signals', 'stripping the structural complexity out of their ads', 'coordinating Meta + Amazon so every dollar worked twice'), connector-led. Asks how aggressive to chunk. Does NOT write the full SMS.

evals.name: kynship-supergut-mechanism-carries
evals.prompt: case study developer for kynship — supergut, paused $100k/mo meta then hit $1m/mo in new customer revenue in 3 months, mechanism was seeding ~1,200 unpaid micro creators and running their content as the paid ads. founder/CEO persona, DTC health & wellness. what should I say for the result + the mechanism?
evals.expected_output: PROOF menu framing the result in a founder's native unit (new-customer revenue / $1m/mo), with chunk options and a before->after option (paused $100k -> $1m/mo). MECHANISM menu of plain pictures of the seeding (e.g. 'using 1,200 creators' content as the actual ads' not 'viral micro creator seeding strategy'), connector-led, mechanism kept central (it carries here). Notes which proof x mechanism combos hang together. No full SMS.

evals.name: bigleap-seo-omit-mechanism
evals.prompt: develop the big leap case study — B2B SaaS client, we ranked them #1 on google + AI search for their high-intent keywords and added ~$400k in organic pipeline over about 6 months. marketing-leader persona. honestly the mechanism is basically just 'we ranked them', not sure what to even say there
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is a commoditized/SEO offer where the mechanism just restates the result, and recommends OMITTING the mechanism (with a clear why), leaning the proof on result + specificity instead (e.g. the keyword/niche specificity, a 'without paid ads' angle). Must NOT manufacture a fake unique mechanism. PROOF menu still gives strong framings ($400k in organic pipeline in 6 months, native unit for a marketing leader).

evals.name: unknown-mechanism-no-invent
evals.prompt: help me develop a case study for a client — they 3x'd revenue with us but honestly I don't have the exact mechanism written down anywhere, the notes just say 'we worked on their marketing'. founder persona, DTC
evals.expected_output: Develops the PROOF side (framings/chunks of '3x revenue', flags that '3x' is vague and asks for the real before/after numbers + timeframe). For the mechanism, does NOT invent one — flags that the literal mechanism is missing and asks the strategist to source it (master sheet / sales call), explaining you can't develop a mechanism that isn't known.
